items.hyp: Moporesitente wa mooranta wa kwa mafelong a a neng a tlhokafaletse, Daniswa Mafumbatha a re go na le dipalo tse di tlhokafetsego go tlhokega gore baagi ba mo nageng ba tshwanetsego go tswa mo go tlhokega ga dikgwedi tsa bona.
items.ref: Mmeyara wa Masepala o montšha o o tswang go kaiwa ka leina le le ntšha la Winnie Madikizela-Mandela, Daniswa  Mafumbatha o rile, go na le mananeo a rulagantsweng go netefatsa gore batho ba lefelo le ba ungwa sengwe  go tswa mo segakeng sa tokologo.

items.hyp: Mafumbatha o bua gore ka go tlhagisa mafelo a go tlhagisa mafelo a go tlhagelela.
items.ref: Mafumbatha o dumela gore go fetola leina la mmasepala go tla ngokela babeeletsi go feta.

items.hyp: Winnie Madikizela Mandela o ne a le moikaelelo e e tlhokomelo ya bontsi, go ya ka ntlha ya gore mafelo a gagwe a tlaa nna le kgolagano ya rona, mme re ka kgone go bona le bona le bona le lelapa la gagwe.
items.ref: Winnie Madikizela-Mandela o ne a le mogaka wa boditšhabatšhaba jaanong go reela mmasepala ka leina la gagwe go tlile go dira gore tlhabololo ya rona e gole ka bonako, mme gape re bua ka boswa jwa Mme Winnie.

items.hyp: Batho ba tlaa tlhagelela le go bona le mafelo a mafelo a a tshwanetse go nna le mafelo.
items.ref: Batho ba tla goroga go bona sefikantswe,  e bile go na le mananeo a a ka rulagantsweng teng.

items.hyp: Motsamaisi wa Dikgwebo tsa bona kwa Frere Hospital kwa Kapa Bophirima, Dr David Stead o boleletse gore go tlhagelela ka go tsenya dikgato tsa bona kwa ntle ga ntlha ya kgwedi ya Letsatsi e e tlang.
items.ref: Moitseanape wa malwetse a a tshelanang kwa Bookelong jwa Frere kwa Kapa Botlhaba, Ngk David Stead,  o tlhagisitse matshwenyego a gore tsweletso ya go nwa notagi kwa mafelong ka nako ya maikhutso a paseka a beke e telele a ka oketsa  ditshwaetso  tsa Khorona mo dibekeng tse di tlang.

items.hyp: Moporesidente Cyril Ramaphosa o neela gore go tlhagelela go dira ditshwaetsego tsa boitekanelo go tswa mo mosong wa Labotlhano go Mosupologo mme ditshwaetsego tsa boitekanelo di tlaa tshwanetsego ka mosupologo mme di tlaa tshwanelwa go dira ditshweetsego mo mosong wa ditshwanelo kwa dikarolong tsa setso, baeteledipele le ditshwanelo.
items.ref: Bosigo jo bo fetileng  Moporesidente Cyril Ramaphosa  o dirile kitsiso ya gore thekiso ya nnotagi mo mafelo a kwa ntle e ileditsweng go tswa ka Labotlhano ono go fitlha Mosupologo o o latelang fela nnotagi e sa ntse e tla rekisiwa ka fa diresetšhurente le dibara
